title.name: Two cores
title.headline: Two cores. One answer.
title.support: An AI guide for city services, and a second core that watches the deadlines.
title.poster: Two glowing cores, one cyan and one orange, side by side inside a glass case.

question.name: The question
question.headline: Every trip starts with: what do I bring?
question.support: One missing paper means another trip and another morning in line.
question.poster: A long corridor drawn in thin lines, with people waiting in a queue and sheets of paper in the air.

guide.name: Core 1, the Guide
guide.headline: It understands you. Filipino, English, Taglish.
guide.support: Ask the way you talk. Core 1 is designed to work out which city service you mean.
guide.poster: The glass case open, the cyan core in front with rings spreading out from it.

journey.name: One question, followed

shots.headline: Checks every request.
shots.support: Before anything is looked up, your question is checked for safety.

shots.headline: Finds the exact service.
shots.support: Your words become one exact service, out of 40 across 4 city offices.

shots.headline: Reads only the city's charter.
shots.support: Requirements, fees, steps and the office come from the city's own Citizen Charter. Core 1 never changes the city's records.

shots.headline: Never makes things up.
shots.support: Every item on your list is taken from the charter. Nothing is invented.

journey.poster: A beam from the cyan core fans out to four groups of points, one group for each city office. One point is lit.

answer.name: The answer
answer.headline: What to bring. Where to go. Straight from the charter.
answer.support: A checklist you can save and tick off, stored on your phone.
answer.note: Sample layout. A real answer lists the charter's own items.
answer.poster: A dark sphere with a bright orange ring, and a checklist card opening out of it.

watch.name: Core 2, the Watch
watch.headline: It never stops watching the deadlines.
watch.support: For city staff. Core 2 is designed to follow each request and compare it with the deadlines in the charter and the law.
watch.poster: The orange core inside a clock ring with one hand.

request.name: One request, followed
request.headline: A person decides. Core 2 only drafts.
request.support: When a step runs late, Core 2 drafts an early heads-up. Staff review it before anything is sent.
request.outside: Waiting on another agency isn't blamed on the office
request.alertTitle: Early heads-up, drafted for staff review
request.alertBody: One step is past its deadline.
request.poster: A glowing thread through five steps. One stretch is grey. Past the fourth step's deadline the thread burns bright orange.

together.name: Together
together.headline: Citizens know what to bring. Offices see delays early.
together.poster: Both cores side by side in the glass case, each with a ring pulsing round it.

close.name: Start
close.headline: Ask your first question.
close.support: Built from the published Citizen Charters of 4 city offices and their 40 services.
close.poster: A dark sphere with an orange ring.
